d:
Prayagraj Police received information that money had been buried on a plot of land at a house, following which they arrived to conduct a search. During the excavation, police recovered a large amount of cash from blue drums buried underground.
The cash has been seized and securely deposited in the malkhana (police station storeroom) at Nawabganj police station. The official counting of the recovered money is still underway, but preliminary estimates suggest that the amount could run into several crores of rupees.
